title: DIMASSOC main-handle vector transport and bounded encoder support
scope: Preserve every AcDbOsnapPointRef main object handle through DWG parsing, the typed model, bounded DWG encoding, and ASCII/Binary DXF parsing and writing. Keep the first handle mirrored in the existing scalar member for source compatibility. This receipt qualifies selected record transport only.

implementation.summary: The typed reference now stores all main handles and mirrors the first in m_objectHandle. DWG parsing retains every counted handle; the bounded type-0 DWG encoder writes the vector after validating count and alias consistency. DXF parsing retains repeated group 331 entries, and DXF output remaps, validates graph closure for, and emits every handle. Physical transport checks every main target. Scalar-only callers remain supported by falling back to m_objectHandle when the vector is empty.
implementation.sourceCompatibility: Existing scalar-only source callers remain supported; binary ABI qualification is still open under P8.
implementation.generatedSamples: Generated DWG vectors are constructed in C++; no sample DWG or DXF fixture was added.
